draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 7.05, the 1st-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 1st of 23 at DT. He went 9th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Jeffery Simmons. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 3 sacks in 2022, 9th of 23 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Philadelphia Eagles. 43 career games and 27 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 9 AV in 2025 against a career-best 14 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 9 (95th percentile), qb hits 12 (88th percentile), pressures 17 (87th percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 15.4% (6th percentile). Played 11 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 interior lineman who played: 17 pressures against a median of 4, above the norm.
